text: since we have about 1000+ more pixels of vertical height i want you to really take advantage of it. Show me the variations side by side rather than just a toggle icon, show me statistics like 'this has been used n times' or what not. show me the capability to favorite it or rename it
resolution: Updated the hmsc workspace mock to use the extra vertical height in the material catalog. Materials now render as taller rows with visible side-by-side variants, usage stats, recipe/seed/bank metadata, favorite controls, and a selected-material section with rename, favorite, stats, and larger variant tiles. Verified with bundle and raw ReleaseFast ship.
